scope: Existing HIA Core, explicit finite profiles, actual migration, NDU and Agent observations
status_policy: Closed refers only to the named checked profile. Failed or unevaluated research claims remain open; test counts and reference controls cannot substitute for them.

blocks.closed_condition: Captured bytes are actually supplied to Clang; bounded process capture and path/IR guards pass their concrete counterexamples.
blocks.excluded: Filesystem containment or correctness of a compromised compiler

blocks.closed_condition: 449/449 registered obligations verified, 0 unknown/refuted; independent signed/unsigned cursor arithmetic checks and mutation controls pass.
blocks.excluded: All programs, memory, loops, concurrency, LLVM optimization and final machine code

blocks.closed_condition: Fresh scalar entry: at most 3 allocator visits/nonzero requests and 32 bytes cumulative/live logical payload; 19 tests and independent graph accounting, plus integrated source re-execution.
blocks.excluded: RSS, allocator overhead, metadata, stack, termination, concurrency, abort cleanup or native refinement

blocks.closed_condition: Actual internal proof/sealed-image admission with bounded leases, transactional publication, retained unknown-close debt, bounded compiler identity; 24/24 native lifecycle regressions and all formal episode releases pass.
blocks.excluded: External receipt admission, arbitrary kernels or general native safety theorem

blocks.closed_condition: 11 upstream bodies/3 source TUs, separate authored CRC TU and client, native differences, lifecycle failures, scalar ABI and maintenance cases pass.
blocks.excluded: Original pointer/record ABI preservation, arbitrary C++ libraries or measured human migration cost

blocks.closed_condition: Required suites pass on the actual final integrated source with no skipped mandatory tests; old green results cannot qualify the new head.
Real node operations, source/query/policy binding, bounded parsing, atomic refusal and native admission controls on a final frozen source, followed by actual tokenizer capacity checks.
blocks.excluded: Rebranding a full-function replacement as node editing or repairing a model answer

blocks.closed_condition: A separately preregistered capable model/interface qualifies before the matched four-arm main; all requested correctness, resource, token/time, intervention and maintenance metrics are retained.
Actual profitable opportunities and lower complete cost than both strong fixed and complete DP under registered equal information/budgets, with appropriate cold/reuse/change/competition evidence.
blocks.excluded: Model-only DP agreement, shared runtime engineering savings or fabricated/synthetic profitable opportunities

blocks.closed_condition: Preselected HIA candidate passes the registered compound gates against strong semantic/algorithm/layout-matched C/C++/Rust LTO/PGO baselines on the actual application, retaining all costs and samples.
blocks.excluded: Post-hoc weaker reference selection or a universal conclusion from this shared host

blocks.closed_condition: Separate checkable soundness and source-to-Core/Core-to-native refinement arguments covering the claimed type, lifetime, failure, cancellation, recursion, concurrency and foreign-memory domains.
blocks.excluded: Rust implementation language, unit tests or selected scalar SMT checks as substitutes

blocks.closed_condition: Representative actual C++ components, original ABI/lifetime/callback boundaries, real maintenance tasks and complete measured migration cost across claimed target platforms.
blocks.excluded: The bounded C vertical slice as evidence of arbitrary C++ conversion

blocks.closed_condition: A finite declared search space, objective, resource budget and environment model with checkable feasibility and an optimality certificate or explicitly bounded regret.
blocks.excluded: Claiming actual universal global optimality for unrestricted programs from NDU or finite-DP agreement

measurement_environment: Shared cloud development host; not a dedicated performance machine or an observed user dot
